REPUBLIC OF THE PHILIPPINES DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT Francisco Gold Condominium II EDSA Cor. Mapagmahal St., Diliman Quezon City LEGAL SERVICE PINOY DILG Opinion No. 26 S. 2011 JUN 15 2011 MR. JOSE ROMEL MURION Tribal Prime Minister Office of the Tribal Prime Minister on Customary Laws & Tradition 717 Molave St. Guingona Subdivision Butuan City Dear Mr. Murion: This pertains to your request for this Department to issue a Special Memorandum Order to our Regional Offices and Local Government Units (LGUs) especially to Bislig City Mayor Librado Navarro prohibiting them from taking any action inconsistent to the rights of the indigenous cultural activities specially the tribal self governance of RA 8371. In reply thereto, please be informed that this Department had already issued Memorandum Circular No. 2002-89, dated 6 June 2002 on the strict implementation of Republic Act No. 8371 or "The Indigenous Rights Act of 1997 (IPRA). In the said Memorandum Circular, all Local Chief Executives, Sanggunian Members and other local officials were directed to uphold and ensure the free exercise of the rights of ICCs/IPs in their respective jurisdiction as provided for in the IPRA including but not limited to the following: Right to Develop Lands and Natural Resources Right to stay in the Territories Equal Protection and Non-discrimination of ICCs/IPs Freedom from Discrimination and Right to Equal Opportunity and Treatment

Basic Services Women Children and Youth Exemption from Taxes Right in case of Displacement Right to Safe and Clean Air and Water Self Governance Right to participate in Decision Making Right to Determine and Decide Priorities for Development Tribal Barangays Role of Peoples Organizations With the said directives to the local officials relative to the strict implementation of the IPRA, we see no reason for the issuance of another Special Memorandum Order prohibiting any action inconsistent to the rights of the indigenous cultural activities specially the tribal self governance of RA 8371. Hope we have enlightened you on the matter. Very truly yours, .J SB. Director III LS:94/11 OQUE W
